title: ArcBio Continuous RNA Workflow - Post-PCR Instrument: RNA-POST-PCR-3 Post-Indexing Cleanup
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Initialize workflow parameters
steps.instruction: Run the ArcBio Continuous RNA Workflow (Post‑PCR Instrument) on the OT‑2 robot (instrument RNA‑POST‑PCR‑3) as part 7 of a 9‑part workflow to process up to 96 input RNA samples into cDNA libraries.

steps.title: Process beads with input sample
steps.instruction: Mix the magnetic beads with the input sample, engage the magnetic module to capture the beads, and carefully remove the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add beads to the input sample and mix thoroughly.
Engage the magnetic module to immobilize the beads.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant without disturbing the bead pellet.

steps.title: Wash beads twice with 80% ethanol
steps.instruction: Perform two consecutive washes of the bead pellet using 80 % ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 80 % ethanol to the beads and gently resuspend.
Remove the ethanol supernatant while the beads remain on the magnet.
Repeat the ethanol wash a second time.

steps.title: Elute beads with Tris
steps.instruction: Elute the nucleic acids from the beads by adding Tris buffer, then proceed to the off‑deck thermocycler steps.
